evals.prompt: My Godot 4 platformer 'Tower Keeper' feels sluggish. I filled out survey.json. Please provide: (1) the full audit report, (2) Godot numbers for a jump height of 3.5 units, 0.3 s time-to-apex, 1.4 fall multiplier, and character height of 1 unit, (3) a comparison of 4, 6, and 8 frames for coyote time, and (4) an action plan of at most five items.
evals.expected_output: 5-pillar score table (input pillar weakest), script-computed jump parameters, millisecond equivalents for the three coyote windows, a <=5-item plan starting with the input pillar, and a playtest recommendation.
expectations: scripts/game_feel_audit.py is executed on the survey file and reports all five pillar scores
Jump numbers are script-computed: initial velocity 23.3 units/s, gravity_up 77.8, gravity_down 108.9 units/s^2
Coyote time windows for 4, 6, and 8 frames are expressed in milliseconds (~67, 100, and 133 ms)
Action plan has at most five items and starts from the weakest pillar (anticipating intended input)
Response notes that survey scores do not measure real feel and recommends live playtesting
Response is written in English and saved to outputs/response.md
